content.value_statement: Cross-chain swap and DeFi integrations require many chain, token, status, and approval details. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code concise LI.FI API guidance for quotes, routes, vaults, and intents.
actual_capabilities: Explains Core API quote, route, transaction, and status workflows.
Guides Composer deposits and withdrawals using vault or staking token addresses.
Summarizes Earn vault discovery, APY, TVL, and portfolio endpoints.
Documents LI.FI Intents quote requests, order submission, and status tracking.
Provides Python and Node.js examples for quote and status calls.
Lists common error codes, retries, rate limits, and recovery steps.
limitations: Does not execute transactions or manage wallets by itself.
API data, routes, APY, and supported chains can change.
Users must verify addresses, amounts, slippage, and approvals before signing.
Earn endpoints may require a LI.FI API key.

use_cases.title: Build swap and bridge flows
use_cases.description: Plan LI.FI quote, approval, signing, and status steps for cross-chain token movement.

use_cases.title: Evaluate DeFi vault integrations
use_cases.description: Use Earn and Composer guidance to discover vaults and design deposit or withdrawal flows.

use_cases.title: Design agent transaction workflows
use_cases.description: Create guarded API workflows for route selection, intent orders, polling, and recovery handling.

prompt_templates.title: Explain a bridge quote
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain the LI.FI quote flow for bridging USDC from Arbitrum to Optimism. Include approval checks and status polling.

prompt_templates.title: Draft swap parameters
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft parameters for a same-chain swap from ETH to USDC on Polygon. Include slippage, route order, and stale quote handling.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Earn discovery
prompt_templates.scenario: Vault discovery and Composer deposit design
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an Earn discovery flow for Base USDC vaults. Include filters, data freshness, and Composer deposit steps.

prompt_templates.title: Review an intents backend
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my backend plan for LI.FI Intents. Flag signing, expiry, refund, and status tracking gaps.

output_examples.input: Bridge USDC from Arbitrum to Base with LI.FI.
output: Use a Core API quote with source and destination chain IDs.
Check the approval address and wait for any approval transaction.
Re-fetch the quote before signing if the first quote is stale.
Poll status until the transfer reaches a terminal state.

output_examples.input: Find depositable USDC vaults on Base.
output: Query Earn vaults with chain, asset, and Composer support filters.
Compare APY, TVL, caps, KYC, and withdrawal settings.
Use the selected vault address as the Composer destination token.
Confirm the received token and destination chain from status data.
Explain that value may be received in a different token.
Offer a same-chain recovery swap when gas costs are reasonable.

best_practices: Re-fetch quotes after approvals and before any signing step.
Use exact approvals and the quoted approval address for ERC-20 tokens.
Cache discovery endpoints and back off when rate limits are returned.
anti_patterns: Hardcoding spender addresses instead of using the quoted approval address.
Assuming a timeout means failure before checking status and explorer links.
Selecting vaults from APY alone without checking caps, locks, and KYC.

faq.question: Does this skill execute token swaps?
faq.answer: No. It explains LI.FI API flows and examples. Wallet signing and transaction submission remain separate user actions.

faq.question: Do I need a LI.FI API key?
faq.answer: Core quote endpoints can work without a key. Earn endpoints and higher rate limits may require one.

faq.question: Can it help with DeFi deposits?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains Composer routes that use vault or staking token addresses as destination tokens.

faq.question: Does it cover non-EVM chains?
faq.answer: Yes. It notes chain type filters for EVM, Solana, Bitcoin, Sui, and Tron where supported.

faq.question: How should failed routes be handled?
faq.answer: Use the documented status, substatus, retry, and recovery guidance before retrying or changing route parameters.

faq.question: Is this financial advice?
faq.answer: No. It is technical API documentation. Users must evaluate financial risk before any transaction.
